text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's CRM ingest ~1.9k accounts have no owner and health_score is null. Onboarding_flag shows 'imported' and no touchpoints. Can we auto-queue low-risk accounts for enrichment and surface MRR>500 for manual claim?
aj: Yikes. Ran a quick sample: `SELECT id, mrr, health_score FROM accounts WHERE owner IS NULL LIMIT 10;` most are $0-$150 but there are ~120 with MRR>500. Short plan: create an 'orphan-backfill' queue + playbook: 1) tag source=crm_import, 2) if mrr>500 -> create claim task, 3) else -> auto-enrich + run healthscore calc.
tyler: Agree. Two notes: 1) ensure enrichment writes back before healthscore recompute (race). 2) add a temporary 'health_score_override' for nulls so downstream alerts don't spike.
sophia: Proposed playbook snippet (sandbox):
```yaml
name: orphan-backfill-v1
schedule: nightly@03:00UTC
selectors:
  - owner: null
  - onboarding_flag: imported
steps:
  - tag: { key: source, value: crm_import }
  - if: { condition: mrr > 500 }
    then: { action: create_claim_task, assignee_queue: cs_claims_high_mrr }
    else: { action: call_service, service: enrichment-v2, writeback: true }
  - action: run_healthscore_recompute, wait_for_writeback: true
  - action: add_tag, tag: orphan_backfill_run:{date} 
  - notify: { channel: #customer-success-ops, template: "orphan-backfill-summary" }
```
playbook-bot: Draft created: `orphan-backfill-v1` (sandbox). Preview: 1,920 candidates (MRR>0 filter off). /playbook preview id=pb-20260323-01
cs_ops: Can we add safe-suppression for `do_not_contact` and `gdpr_opt_out` flags so automated nudges/enrichment don't trigger? Also include audit tag `orphan_backfill_run:2026-03-23` for future rollbacks.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job pb-20260323-01 queued (nightly at 03:00 UTC). Estimated runtime ~12m. Logs will post to #customer-success-ops and attach CSV with sample 100 accounts.
maria: I'll own coordinating the MRR>500 claim batch and manual triage. Aj — can you share the histogram and a triage CSV (with id,mrr,region,created_at)?
aj: On it. Uploading sample CSV to the drive now: https://drive.redwood.example/s/triage-samples/orphan-backfill-sample.csv. I'll post run counts after the preview completes. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — let's aim to run the enrichment preview tonight and keep the manual claim task off for a dry-run until Monday.
